opened_loci.content: Analytic index equals topological index for an elliptic differential operator on a compact differentiable manifold with differentiable complex vector bundles.

Dolbeault operator for a holomorphic bundle on a compact complex manifold; ellipticity, analytic Euler characteristic and characteristic-class integral; applies also to W tensor exterior powers of the cotangent to obtain chi_y=T_y.

source_match: Verified original title and exact analytic RR application. Compact complex is the stated domain; no additional Kaehler assumption is imposed in this locus.
scope: Source theorem matched as input; no new proof of the Atiyah-Singer index theorem claimed.
